source_evidence: Day330~21:00 exact player 'Hello, what’s going on?' is V's audible greeting/question to the armed group from the existing roadside camp, no additional movement, threat, weapon draw, spell, deception or attack. At about80ft the group hears the raised voice, halts and turns toward visible campfire. Its apparent leader (fixed Veteran, private) calls back 'Keep to your fire, traveler. These two are thieves. We're taking them to answer for it.' The woman already heard protesting calls back 'That's a lie! They took us from our home!' A guard orders her quiet. Her words are her firsthand claim; the leader's justification is a deliberate false cover for the already-fixed ransom abduction, not an established lawful warrant or proof V can yet see. No additional origin, ransom amount, relationship, faction link or injuries established. Escort remains on the road ~80ft away within original 30ft grouping, westward travel momentarily halted, one torch; existing low hawthorn/ditch and light unchanged. The group now knows there is at least one interlocutor at camp but not party identities, exact strength or hidden details. Leader wants to avoid trouble and move on with captives; no new attack, pursuit, initiative, guaranteed surprise, concession, roll or resource change. V chooses next action.
